name: 2-Block Littlestone Dimension of Tagged Singletons
proof: VC dimension is one, which gives a depth-one level-constant tree. A 2-block tree of depth two has one common coordinate at its second level, so its four leaves realize all labelings on two fixed coordinates. This would give VC dimension at least two, which is impossible.
references: Directly from the block-tree definition and the VC calculation for this class in \cite{maass1992lower}.
